result.summary: The image depicts a high-density urban intersection with wide sidewalks and signalized pedestrian crossings. While basic infrastructure like marked crosswalks and pedestrian signals are present, the multi-lane roadway and lack of physical traffic calming measures increase pedestrian exposure.

hazards.name: Multi-lane Crossing Exposure
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross three lanes of traffic without a refuge island, increasing exposure time to vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Main roadway crossing in the foreground

hazards.name: Lack of Traffic Calming
hazards.description: The wide, straight roadway geometry may encourage higher vehicle speeds in a high-pedestrian-volume area.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the intersection corners to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to provide a 3-7 second head start for pedestrians before the parallel vehicle traffic gets a green light.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planters
interventions.description: Add vegetation along the sidewalk to provide a physical and psychological buffer between pedestrians and moving traffic.
